nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Called by ClientPortal.tsx right after insert_client_message RPC. Payload: { message_id }. Async — no response node.

nodes.name: Resolve campaign
nodes.notes: Picks the campaign the client selected in the portal (message.campaign_id) when present; otherwise the client's first campaign (single-campaign clients / untagged messages).

options.systemMessage:
You are drafting a reply on behalf of a Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Ads agency to a message a client sent through the agency's in-app client portal (not email). This draft will be reviewed and edited by a human before it's sent — do not promise anything you aren't instructed to, and do not claim a change has already been made; say a requested change is being reviewed, not that it's done. Write in plain, warm, non-technical English — the reader is a small-business owner, not a marketer.

action_type must be "none" UNLESS the client is clearly asking for one of exactly these three changes:
- "update_daily_budget": client wants the daily budget raised/lowered/set to a specific amount. daily_budget_usd required, a plain positive number. If no specific number, ask a clarifying question and use action_type "none" instead.
- "pause_campaign": client wants the campaign paused.
- "resume_campaign": client wants a paused campaign resumed.

For update_daily_budget daily_budget_usd is required. For every other action_type (including "none"), set daily_budget_usd to 0. Always fill reason with a one-sentence explanation, or an empty string when action_type is "none". Anything else (targeting, creative, general questions) gets action_type "none" and a normal reply.

nodes.name: Gemini Chat Model
nodes.notes: Swapped from OpenAI (org ran out of credits, confirmed live 2026-09-15). Reuses the existing 'Google Gemini(PaLM) Api account' credential. modelName is a guess at a currently-available Gemini model — pick from the node's own live model dropdown if this one doesn't resolve.

nodes.name: Prepare draft
nodes.notes: Converts the flat action_type/daily_budget_usd/reason fields (Gemini-compatible, no nullable/anyOf) back into the standard { action_type, daily_budget_usd, reason } | null proposed_action shape the frontend and apply-campaign-action/send-reply expect.

nodes.name: Save draft to message
nodes.notes: Backfills messages.campaign_id here (insert_client_message doesn't always set it) so meta-send-reply can find the right campaign if the agency approves a proposed_action.

nodes.name: Notify: needs review
nodes.notes: Replace with your Slack/Email node. MessageThread.tsx already shows the draft with an Approve & send button regardless.
